name: Private equity
summary: Anthropic's financial-services plugins, the data vendors they bring, connector and compliance defaults, and the deal-team tasks for a private-equity firm.

anthropic_starting_points.name: financial-analysis
anthropic_starting_points.note: Adapt. Install it first: it holds all 12 of the repo's connectors, every one third-party and none acceptable by default in the private-equity ZDR org. Vendor a reviewed copy with the .mcp.json deleted (reviewed at commit 3e32c22).

anthropic_starting_points.name: private-equity
anthropic_starting_points.note: Adapt. 10 skills, no agents, hooks or connectors. Vendor a reviewed copy. deal-sourcing and ai-readiness are skipped.

anthropic_starting_points.name: Claude Code zero data retention
anthropic_starting_points.note: Enterprise ZDR covers Claude Code only; chat, Cowork and artifacts are not covered.

anthropic_starting_points.name: Self-hosted Managed Agents
anthropic_starting_points.note: Anthropic recommends one self-hosted deployment per tenant or trust level; we use one deployment per wall.

anthropic_starting_points.name: Managed MCP
anthropic_starting_points.note: allowManagedMcpServersOnly with an allowedMcpServers list also checks servers that plugins add; use it to keep the 12 vendor connectors out.

data_providers.name: Daloopa
data_providers.note: Remote MCP server https://mcp.daloopa.com/server/mcp, shipped in the financial-analysis plugin. Not allowed in the private-equity ZDR org for the pilot: a query shows the vendor what the firm is looking at. Per vendor later, after the vendor test. Its retention and identity model are unconfirmed.

data_providers.note: Remote MCP server https://premium.mcp.pitchbook.com/mcp, shipped in the financial-analysis plugin. data_providers.name: Chronograph
data_providers.note: Remote MCP server https://ai.chronograph.pe/mcp, shipped in the financial-analysis plugin. Not allowed for the pilot. A later candidate for portfolio-monitoring if the firm already uses it, after the compendium 11 review. Its retention and identity model are unconfirmed.

data_providers.name: Egnyte
data_providers.note: Remote MCP server https://mcp-server.egnyte.com/mcp, shipped in the financial-analysis plugin. Not for a firm that uses SharePoint. For a firm that keeps deal files there it is acceptable after the compendium 11 review, per user and read-only. Its retention and identity model are unconfirmed.

data_providers.name: Box
data_providers.note: Remote MCP server https://mcp.box.com, shipped in the financial-analysis plugin. Same as Egnyte. Its retention and identity model are unconfirmed.

connector_defaults.how: Salesforce Hosted MCP Server, with OAuth through an External Client App. Do not use a Claude Tag connection for walled teams.
connector_defaults.identity: Per user. Salesforce's own record sharing then decides what the twin sees.

connector_defaults.how: The Microsoft 365 connector from the Claude directory; a Global Admin must consent for the tenant. Read by default; admins can turn on writes.
Part of the Microsoft 365 connector. It reads chat and calendar; admins can turn on sending.
connector_defaults.identity: Per user (delegated), the same as SharePoint.

compliance_defaults.reason: Deal-specific material and MNPI are in scope, so they are kept to ZDR surfaces: Claude Code, and hosted agents in the ZDR Platform org.
Decided 2026-11-14: design B, soft walls. One org; the source systems enforce the walls through per-user identity; hard walls stay an upgrade path.

Decided 2026-11-14: accept 30-day retention for chat as the starting point and keep deal material to ZDR surfaces. Anthropic's copy is gone after 30 days, so our own governance log is the long-term audit record.
